games.name: HAVOC GXMetal deterministic multi-sortie five-minute gameplay and relaunch lifecycle

steps.note: Candidate route only until a complete run and screenshot/telemetry review. Precondition: HAVOC's saved preference selects 3-D hardware acceleration. Use only a disposable clone with audio and networking disabled. Final10 shows an idle cockpit can leave for promo/help after roughly 40 seconds, so this route uses fifteen independently gated short sorties. Each brackets 8.7 seconds of movement/fire and delay dwell plus a 12-second wait with exact cockpit HUD checks, conservatively accumulating 310.5 seconds of actual HUD-present gameplay before explicit Escape-to-menu transitions.

Normalize menu focus through the retained options-open/cancel route before quitting. This exact focus sequence reached HAVOC's ordinary main menu before successful Command-Q in the v2.2.3 persistent-options evidence; the v2.2.4 hardware diagnostic independently proves the same settings controls.

Clean-exit boundary: Command-Q is evidence-backed after the ordinary main-menu/options-cancel state. Keep this fail-closed: do not claim clean exit or relaunch unless the following Finder and second-process gameplay gates pass.

A qualified review must additionally require at least two distinct context_create_generations in result.json. The second-process cockpit and input gates force fresh RAVE work, while the result audit—not this JSON manifest—proves that the work belongs to a fresh renderer generation.
